test_title: PYST 22: SSC CGL 2022 - Reasoning (Held On: 07 Dec 2022 Shift 2)
subject: reasoning
question:
Select the figure that will replace the question mark (?) in the following figure series.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c90a523ac6c35c6788b5a40745abc9927033abb0c7709929023480e24a53881a.png]
solution:
The pattern followed in the given series is:

**Each pattern repeats itself in an alternative step.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1634b72d5e06d348e661d3719a0915abb3fee7f5e0b97f85964b2d0f2ef740c4.png] 

Next step:

**The pattern in the second step will repeat itself in the fourth step.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e39c5ce0824dbfaf95ef7cdac167b7eb802be54b49f0705049cfa48c9831007.png] 

Now we consider the given options:

Option 1) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/6e39c5ce0824dbfaf95ef7cdac167b7eb802be54b49f0705049cfa48c9831007.png] There is one extra circle.

Option 2) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/2d2cc615468096fefc6b11e960bc404c3e5f6c38c7208c290aac8c973169aca0.png] **The pattern is correct.**

Option 3) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/446b178b9a630fb2c317ff11a19f2d1f36cef80182f00fc55e2036042a0b7a75.png] There is one extra circle & the rectangle is upside down.

Option 4) [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/65e99f1befc9960204cf7d6613afc1c19e08a6c570a600556c4f4dd4deb8c1b3.png] The rectangle is shaded upside.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2".**
